gbm_population_evidence.quote: Participants who have the appearance of high-grade glioma (HGG, WHO Grade 3 and 4, including GBM) on MR imaging are allowed to consent and will undergo the procedure if the frozen is consistent with HGG

candidate_evidence.quote: Intraoperative Electrocorticography: Each participant will undergo intraoperative electrocorticography (ECOG) through subdural grid (SDG) and depth electrode (DE) via FDA-cleared, standardized, brain recording technology.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Participants with a history of histologically-confirmed diagnosis of high- grade glioma that are undergoing resection of a recurrent/progressive tumor that is likely recurrent/progressive high- grade glioma as identified on preoperative MR imaging

coder_notes: Procedure-only study (intraoperative electrocorticography and biopsy); no drug or biologic interventions. Treatment setting coded both because the first inclusion bullet covers newly suspected HGG at surgery and the second covers recurrent/progressive tumour. Transcriptomic correlation is an unspecified exploratory analysis, not coded as a biomarker.
